If any target hasn't used their own Cackletongue maneuver on this turn, they can use it immediately at no cost. > ⭐️ **Death Rampage** > > Whenever a non-[minion](scc.v1:mcdm.monsters.v1/rule.organization/minion) ally within 5 squares of the carnage is reduced to 0 [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina), the carnage can move up to their speed, then can either make a melee [free strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.main-actions/free-strike) against two creatures or use Shrapnel Whip against one creature. > ⭐️ **[End Effect](scc.v1:mcdm.monsters.v1/rule.monster/end-effect)** > > At the end of each of their turns, the carnage can take 5 damage to end one effect on them that can be ended by a saving throw. This damage can't be reduced in any way. > ⭐️ **Endless Hunger** > > If the carnage is reduced to 0 [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina) while there are still gnolls on the encounter map, one gnoll on the map is transformed into a gnoll carnage, keeping their current [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina). > ☠️ **Call Up From the Abyss ([Villain Action](scc.v1:mcdm.monsters.v1/rule.monster/villain-action) 1)** > > | **Magic, Ranged** | **-** | > |-------------------|---------------:| > | **📏 Ranged 10** | **🎯 Special** | > > **Effect:** The carnage summons four abyssal hyenas into unoccupied spaces within distance. > ☠️ **Edacity ([Villain Action](scc.v1:mcdm.monsters.v1/rule.monster/villain-action) 2)** > > | **Area** | **-** | > |-----------------|-----------------------------:| > | **📏 10 burst** | **🎯 Self and three allies** | > > **Effect:** Each target moves up to their speed and can make a [free strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.main-actions/free-strike). Any creature damaged by one of these [free strikes](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.main-actions/free-strike) who has M < 2 is knocked [prone](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/prone). > ☠️ **Deepest Wounds ([Villain Action](scc.v1:mcdm.monsters.v1/rule.monster/villain-action) 3)** > > | **Area, Magic** | **-** | > |-----------------|-------------------------------------:| > | **📏 5 burst** | **🎯 Each [winded](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/winded) enemy in the area** | > > **Effect:** The carnage's eyes and all exposed blood within distance glow bright red. Each target makes a **Presence test**. > > - **≤11:** The target can't regain [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina) until the end of the encounter. > - **12-16:** The target can't regain [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina) (save ends). > - **17+:** No effect > > **Effect:** Until the end of the encounter, all gnolls have a double edge on power rolls that target a [winded](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/winded) enemy.
